scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @job-board/web" "npm run dev -w @job-board/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @job-board/contracts && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @job-board/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @job-board/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @job-board/api && npm run test:coverage -w @job-board/web
